import ast,base64,hashlib,json,struct,zlib
from pathlib import Path
from fractions import Fraction as F
root=Path.cwd()
report=json.loads((root/'coordinacion/respuestas/AXIAL-NATIVE-SOURCE-ENCODER-001-CODEX.json').read_bytes())
sha=lambda raw:hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
canonical=lambda value:json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False).encode()
def retained(r):
 t=r['test_run'];assert type(t['rc']) is int and t['rc']==0
 raw=zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(t['stdout_zlib_base64'],validate=True))
 assert len(raw)==t['stdout_bytes'] and sha(raw)==t['stdout_sha256']
 return json.loads(raw)
for path,h in report['code_doc_sha256'].items():assert sha((root/path).read_bytes())==h,path
run=retained(report);assert run['PASS'] is True and run['tests']==9
old=retained(json.loads((root/'coordinacion/respuestas/AXIAL-NATIVE-INGRESS-001-CODEX.json').read_bytes()))
plan=retained(json.loads((root/'coordinacion/respuestas/AXIAL-NATIVE-EVIDENCE-CONTRACT-001-CODEX.json').read_bytes()))['plan']
assert set(run['cases'])==set(old['packets'])==set(plan['cases'])
def component(w,bits):
 assert type(w) is int and 0<=w<2**bits
 value=struct.unpack('<f' if bits==32 else '<d',struct.pack('<I' if bits==32 else '<Q',w))[0]
 return F(value)
def nearest(q):
 # Independent monotone word search, NOT producer integer exponent/grid algorithm.
 if abs(q)>=F(2**128-2**103):raise ValueError('overflow')
 value=abs(q);lo=0;hi=0x7f7fffff
 while lo<hi:
  mid=(lo+hi+1)//2
  if component(mid,32)<=value:lo=mid
  else:hi=mid-1
 candidates=[lo]+([lo+1] if lo<0x7f7fffff else [])
 chosen=min(candidates,key=lambda w:(abs(component(w,32)-value),w&1,w))
 if 0<chosen<0x00800000:raise ValueError('subnormal')
 return chosen|((1<<31) if q<0 and chosen!=0 else 0)
def check_encoding(s):
 orig=[component(w,64) for w in s['original_source_uint64']]
 represented=[];error=F(0)
 for i,q in enumerate(orig):
  h,l=s['source_limb_uint32'][2*i:2*i+2]
  assert h==nearest(q)
  residual=q-component(h,32)
  assert l==nearest(residual)
  value=component(h,32)+component(l,32)
  represented.append(value);error+=abs(q-value)
  trace=s['HOST_trace'][i]
  assert F(*trace['original'])==q and trace['high_uint32']==h and F(*trace['high'])==component(h,32)
  assert F(*trace['HOST_exact_residual'])==residual and trace['low_uint32']==l
  assert F(*trace['represented'])==value and F(*trace['encoding_error'])==abs(q-value)
 assert list(map(lambda v:F(*v),s['source_exact_limb_sum_rational']))==represented
 assert F(*s['source_encoding_error_L1'])==error
 assert F(*s['source_norm_L1'])==sum(map(abs,orig),F(0))
 raw=base64.b64decode(s['source_hilo_le_base64'],validate=True)
 assert len(raw)==16 and list(struct.unpack('<4I',raw))==s['source_limb_uint32']
 assert sha(raw)==s['source_hilo_le_sha256']
 assert s['costs']=={'new_HOST_RN32':4,'new_HOST_exact_residual_subtractions':2,
                    'cached_encoding_operations_NOT_executed':0}
 assert s['model']==report['model'] and s['GPU_executed'] is False and s['native_promotion_allowed'] is False
counts={'cases':0,'source_IDs':0,'matched_retained_encodings':0,'main_HOST_RN32':0,'main_HOST_residual_subtractions':0,
'all_RN32_attempted':0,'all_RN32_successful':0,'all_RN32_rejected':0,'all_successful_encodings':0,
'all_HOST_residual_subtractions':0,'source_hilo_bytes_main':0}
for name,c in run['cases'].items():
 p=old['packets'][name];bufs={k:base64.b64decode(v,validate=True) for k,v in p['buffers_base64'].items()}
 meta=json.loads(bufs['input_metadata_json']);snapshot=json.loads(bufs['original_scene_json'])
 assert c['input_packet_sha256']==sha(canonical(p))
 for key in ('scene_binding_sha256','word_ABI_sha256','original_snapshot_sha256','source_order'):
  assert c[key]==meta[key]
 assert c['input_receipts_UNCHANGED']==p['manifest']['buffers']
 assert canonical(c['original_path_phase_caps_UNCHANGED'])==canonical(meta['original_path_phase_caps'])
 assert canonical(c['group_contract_UNCHANGED'])==canonical(meta['explicit_group_contract'])
 for flag in ('GPU_executed','GPU_job_admission','native_kernel_implemented','accepted_full_field_pipeline',
 'coherence_authenticated','execution_authenticated'):assert c[flag] is False
 assert c['encoding_error_not_yet_propagated_through_unit_or_detector'] is True
 assert c['source_order']==[s['source_id'] for s in c['fields']]==[s['id'] for s in snapshot['sources']]
 fields={s['source_id']:s for s in c['fields']}
 packed=b''
 for i,s in enumerate(c['fields']):
  check_encoding(s)
  assert s['original_source_uint64']==list(struct.unpack('<QQ',bufs['sources'][128*i+112:128*i+128]))
  assert s['source_phase_reference_id']=='original-source-zero:'+meta['scene_binding_sha256']+':'+s['source_id']
  packed+=base64.b64decode(s['source_hilo_le_base64'],validate=True)
  counts['source_IDs']+=1
 for prior in plan['cases'][name]['expected_source_outputs']:
  if prior['source_limb_uint32'] is not None:
   assert fields[prior['source_id']]['source_limb_uint32']==prior['source_limb_uint32']
   counts['matched_retained_encodings']+=1
 assert base64.b64decode(c['source_hilo_buffer_base64'],validate=True)==packed
 assert sha(packed)==c['source_hilo_buffer_sha256'] and c['source_stride_words']==4
 assert c['costs']=={'new_HOST_RN32':4*len(c['fields']),'new_HOST_exact_residual_subtractions':2*len(c['fields']),
                    'cached_encoding_operations_NOT_executed':0}
 counts['cases']+=1;counts['source_hilo_bytes_main']+=len(packed)
 counts['main_HOST_RN32']+=c['costs']['new_HOST_RN32']
 counts['main_HOST_residual_subtractions']+=c['costs']['new_HOST_exact_residual_subtractions']
for s in run['controls'].values():check_encoding(s)
for s in run['all_new_successful_encodings_including_tests_and_controls']:
 check_encoding(s);counts['all_successful_encodings']+=1
for row in run['all_new_RN32_calls_including_tests_and_controls']:
 q=F(*row['input_rational']);counts['all_RN32_attempted']+=1
 try:expected=nearest(q)
 except ValueError:
  assert row['rejected'] is True
  counts['all_RN32_rejected']+=1
 else:
  assert row['rejected'] is False and row['output_uint32']==expected
  counts['all_RN32_successful']+=1
counts['all_HOST_residual_subtractions']=2*counts['all_successful_encodings']
assert counts['all_HOST_residual_subtractions']==run['all_new_HOST_exact_residual_subtractions_including_tests_and_controls']
assert counts['main_HOST_RN32']==run['new_HOST_RN32_main']==56
assert counts['main_HOST_residual_subtractions']==run['new_HOST_exact_residual_subtractions_main']==28
assert run['new_HOST_RN32_controls']==4*len(run['controls'])==20
assert run['new_HOST_exact_residual_subtractions_controls']==2*len(run['controls'])==10
assert counts['cases']==13 and counts['source_IDs']==14 and counts['matched_retained_encodings']==6
tree=ast.parse((root/'Blender/benchmarks/capacity_audit/axial_native_source_encoder_v1.py').read_bytes())
imports={node.names[0].name if isinstance(node,ast.Import) else node.module
 for node in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(node,(ast.Import,ast.ImportFrom))}
assert imports=={'base64','fractions','hashlib','json','pathlib','struct','zlib'}
print(json.dumps({'PASS':True,'pins_verified':len(report['code_doc_sha256']),'counts':counts,
 'producer_modules_imported':0,'GPU_executed':False,'nearest_oracle':'independent monotone binary32 word search'},sort_keys=True))
